prs_opened.label: PRs opened
prs_opened.definition: Distinct pull request URLs in the ledger, including all outcomes.

prs_merged.label: PRs merged
prs_merged.definition: Distinct PRs with a saved merged outcome.
prs_merged.note: Saved state only; this command does not refresh GitHub.

prs_open.label: PRs open
prs_open.definition: Distinct PRs with a saved open outcome. Open sub-states: awaiting-cla is agreement; otherwise no-reply requires silent status or explicit responded.maintainer=false and responded.community=false, with neither a true human response flag nor in-review/community-review status. A human response flag or in-review/community-review status is in-review; other submissions are unchecked. Source: factory/oss/followup.py:341-351,394-409; factory/oss/submit.py:336-339.
prs_open.note: Saved state only; this command does not refresh GitHub.

prs_closed.label: PRs closed
prs_closed.definition: Distinct PRs with a saved closed outcome.
prs_closed.note: Saved state only; this command does not refresh GitHub.

cohort_merge_rate.label: Cohort merge rate
cohort_merge_rate.definition: Merged / all PRs opened on or before the date 14 days before the snapshot date (UTC). Closed and unanswered PRs stay in the denominator; exact timestamps establish opening dates.
cohort_merge_rate.note: 95% Wilson interval assumes independent PRs; repository clustering limits that assumption.

merged_no_rework_share.label: Merged without rework
merged_no_rework_share.definition: Merged without rework: merged with no formal change request, no content change pushed by the author after opening, and no repair by a maintainer before merging / merged. Uses cohort merges with complete cached histories. Unclassified maintainer edits count against the share. Maintainer scope changes, refactors, style changes, tests, release notes, bot commits and base merges are recorded and do not count; merge-from-base commits are excluded.
merged_no_rework_share.source: Saved role-only PR history; validated outcome classifications
merged_no_rework_share.note: Incomplete merged histories are excluded from this denominator and reduce coverage. Commit dates proxy ordinary push times; force-push times are exact.

decided_merge_rate.label: Merged among decided
decided_merge_rate.definition: Merged / (merged + closed without merge) over all saved PRs, not only the mature cohort.
decided_merge_rate.note: Leaves out pull requests that are still open, so on the same data it reads higher than the cohort merge rate.

fixes_pushed_after_review.label: PRs with fixes pushed after review
fixes_pushed_after_review.definition: PRs with a self non-merge commit or force-push after submission and after the first non-self review. Total updates counts distinct commits and force-push events, not network push batches or proven code defects.
fixes_pushed_after_review.source: GitHub PR metadata, paginated reviews, issue timeline and commits: saved role-only history cache
fixes_pushed_after_review.note: Coverage is complete cached histories / ledger PRs; unavailable histories are excluded, not clean. Tracked requires at least 90% coverage. Committer dates proxy ordinary pushes, not actual push times or batches; force-push times are exact. Merge commits are excluded. GitHub cannot recover every removed commit or delayed push.

fixes_pushed_before_review.label: Pre-review self-corrections (defect signal)
fixes_pushed_before_review.definition: PRs with a self non-merge commit or force-push after submission before any non-self review, including PRs not yet reviewed. Total updates counts distinct commits and force-push events, not network push batches or proven code defects.
fixes_pushed_before_review.source: GitHub PR metadata, paginated reviews, issue timeline and commits: saved role-only history cache
fixes_pushed_before_review.note: Coverage is complete cached histories / ledger PRs; unavailable histories are excluded, not clean. Tracked requires at least 90% coverage. Committer dates proxy ordinary pushes, not actual push times or batches; force-push times are exact. Merge commits are excluded. GitHub cannot recover every removed commit or delayed push.

review_fix_hours.label: Review request to pushed fix
review_fix_hours.definition: Median hours from each non-self CHANGES_REQUESTED review to the next self non-merge commit or force-push. Comment-only reviews are too ambiguous to establish a fix request; requests without a subsequent fix are excluded.
review_fix_hours.source: GitHub PR metadata, paginated reviews, issue timeline and commits: saved role-only history cache
review_fix_hours.note: Coverage is complete cached histories / ledger PRs; unavailable histories are excluded, not clean. Tracked requires at least 90% coverage. Committer dates proxy ordinary pushes, not actual push times or batches; force-push times are exact. Merge commits are excluded. GitHub cannot recover every removed commit or delayed push.

median_lead_hours.label: Median candidate-to-PR lead time
median_lead_hours.definition: Median hours from the persisted candidate item's creation to PR submission; scouting before item creation is not recorded. Date-only, naive and reversed timestamps are excluded.
median_lead_hours.source: Item metadata: created_at; PR ledger: submitted_at

candidate_selection_misses.label: Candidate-selection misses
candidate_selection_misses.definition: PRs closed without merge because they were duplicate, already fixed or unwanted; each PR counts once.
candidate_selection_misses.source: PR ledger: closed outcomes; follow-up closure events
candidate_selection_misses.reason: Closure reasons are reported separately; no dedicated candidate-selection-miss classification is recorded. Private notes and generic closed events are not interpreted.

ci_failures_after_submission.label: PRs with observed CI failures
ci_failures_after_submission.definition: Distinct submitted PRs with a failing CI snapshot or a ci-failing follow-up event. Repeated observations count once; this is not a code-caused bug rate.
ci_failures_after_submission.source: PR ledger: checks; follow-up events: ci-failing
ci_failures_after_submission.note: Observed minimum only. Successful latest checks do not prove that earlier runs passed; failures on the base or infrastructure are not attributed to the PR.

post_merge_reverts.label: Post-merge reverts
post_merge_reverts.definition: Merged PRs with a confirmed subsequent revert.
post_merge_reverts.reason: Follow-up stops observing merged PRs; no post-merge incident registry exists. Red/green test reverts are not production reverts.

post_merge_regressions.label: Post-merge regressions
post_merge_regressions.definition: Merged PRs with a confirmed subsequent regression.
post_merge_regressions.reason: Follow-up stops observing merged PRs; no post-merge incident registry exists. Red/green test reverts are not production reverts.

independent_review_rounds_per_pr.label: Pre-publication independent review rounds per PR
independent_review_rounds_per_pr.definition: Mean preserved independent review verdicts per PR with review records; current and numbered archives are deduplicated by head and verdict.
independent_review_rounds_per_pr.source: Item review files and numbered review archives
independent_review_rounds_per_pr.note: Pre-publication independent reviews, not upstream maintainer rounds. Missing or overwritten archives undercount rounds.

candidates_found.label: Recorded candidates
candidates_found.definition: OSS item records persisted under the runs directory; pre-item scouting ideas are not counted.
candidates_found.note: This is the persisted candidate population, not all opportunities inspected.

candidates_stopped_before_publish.label: Candidates stopped before publishing
candidates_stopped_before_publish.definition: Item records with status dropped, parked, blocked or abandoned, no PR URL and no matching PR in the ledger.
candidates_stopped_before_publish.source: Item metadata: status, pr_url; PR ledger item references

dropped_qualify.label: Rejected at qualification
dropped_qualify.definition: Candidates with a saved skip verdict. Earlier rejections overwritten by a later check are not recoverable.

dropped_value.label: Dropped at value review
dropped_value.definition: Candidates with a complete structured value review whose verdict is drop. Legacy prose is not classified.

sent_back_review.label: Sent back by independent review
sent_back_review.definition: Candidates with at least one preserved fix-needed independent review verdict; each candidate counts once.
sent_back_review.source: Item review files and numbered review archives

agent_minutes_per_pr.label: Agent minutes per PR
agent_minutes_per_pr.definition: Total attributable agent minutes / PRs in the same work cohort.
agent_minutes_per_pr.reason: Shift telemetry excludes nested workers and has no PR attribution. Command runtime is not agent time; dividing partial recent shifts by lifetime PR outcomes would be misleading.

tool_calls_per_pr.label: Tool calls per PR
tool_calls_per_pr.definition: Total attributable tool calls / PRs in the same work cohort.
tool_calls_per_pr.reason: Shift telemetry excludes nested workers and has no PR attribution. Command runtime is not agent time; dividing partial recent shifts by lifetime PR outcomes would be misleading.

agent_minutes_per_merge.label: Agent minutes per merged PR
agent_minutes_per_merge.definition: Total attributable agent minutes / merged PRs in the same work cohort.
agent_minutes_per_merge.reason: Shift telemetry excludes nested workers and has no PR attribution. Command runtime is not agent time; dividing partial recent shifts by lifetime PR outcomes would be misleading.

tool_calls_per_merge.label: Tool calls per merged PR
tool_calls_per_merge.definition: Total attributable tool calls / merged PRs in the same work cohort.
tool_calls_per_merge.reason: Shift telemetry excludes nested workers and has no PR attribution. Command runtime is not agent time; dividing partial recent shifts by lifetime PR outcomes would be misleading.

unattended_shifts.label: Shifts run unattended
unattended_shifts.definition: Completed shifts with no manual intervention from start to finish.
unattended_shifts.reason: Automated launch and exit status do not establish absence of human help. Shifts have no intervention flag or linked intervention log.

owner_interventions.label: Owner interventions per week
owner_interventions.definition: Manual interventions actually performed, grouped by UTC week.
owner_interventions.source: Owner action notes; delegated account-operation records
owner_interventions.reason: Owner action notes mix requests, resolutions and delegated work; account-operation logs record agent actions, not manual interventions. They cannot be counted as human actions.

coordinator_minutes.label: Recorded coordinator minutes
coordinator_minutes.definition: Sum of active_minutes in saved automated-shift summaries; not full-factory cost.
coordinator_minutes.note: Coordinator only. Worker sessions are excluded by the shift summarizer; telemetry covers only retained shift logs.

coordinator_tool_calls.label: Recorded coordinator tool calls
coordinator_tool_calls.definition: Sum of tool_calls in saved automated-shift summaries; not full-factory cost.
coordinator_tool_calls.note: Coordinator only. Worker sessions are excluded by the shift summarizer; telemetry covers only retained shift logs.

shift_completion_rate.label: Shift completion rate
shift_completion_rate.definition: Automated shift summaries with status exactly exited 0 / summaries with a recorded terminal status. Failed starts count against completion.

factory_test_count.label: Factory test count
factory_test_count.definition: Test count or wall-clock runtime from the explicitly supplied full-suite runner report; never inferred from source or unrelated item tests.
factory_test_count.source: Full-suite runner JSON report supplied with --suite-report

factory_test_runtime.label: Factory test runtime
factory_test_runtime.definition: Test count or wall-clock runtime from the explicitly supplied full-suite runner report; never inferred from source or unrelated item tests.
factory_test_runtime.source: Full-suite runner JSON report supplied with --suite-report

factory_defects_found.label: Factory defects found
factory_defects_found.source: Factory git history; no defect registry
factory_defects_found.reason: There is no stable defect identifier linking discovery and resolution. A repair commit may fix several defects or revisit one; commit counts are shown separately.

factory_defects_fixed.label: Factory defects fixed
factory_defects_fixed.source: Factory git history; no defect registry
factory_defects_fixed.reason: There is no stable defect identifier linking discovery and resolution. A repair commit may fix several defects or revisit one; commit counts are shown separately.

factory_fix_commits.label: Factory repair commits
factory_fix_commits.definition: Non-merge commits touching factory, bin, schedule, hooks or tests whose subject begins fix, fixes or fixed. Counts commits, not distinct defects.
factory_fix_commits.note: Only explicitly labeled repair commits; differently worded repairs are excluded.

improvements.happened: A project's automation closed a pull request because it referenced no existing issue.
improvements.change: The policy scan reads a project's pull-request automation as well as its contributing guide, and the release gate checks a required issue reference before a pull request is opened.

improvements.happened: Another contributor opened the same fix shortly before the factory did.
improvements.change: A fix is prepared before its issue is opened, and the pull request follows promptly, with a collision check after the push. Where a project wants discussion or a maintainer's answer first, the issue goes first and the factory waits. Since 2026-11-10, bug reports younger than 48 hours are left alone unless a maintainer invites a pull request.
improvements.moves: Closed: someone else fixed it first

improvements.happened: A fix patched the callers of a shared layer. The maintainer fixed the layer instead and kept the regression test.
improvements.change: Review answers whether the change sits in the layer that owns the contract.
improvements.moves: Closed: the maintainer fixed it another way

improvements.happened: A fix was right, but its generated test matrix was not how the project tests. It was changed on request and then merged.
improvements.change: Each project's conventions are written on a note for that project, its repository card, which the implementer receives with the task.

improvements.happened: A maintainer closed a fix as a non-real issue: the input came from the factory probing the code, not from any project. Two later closures also cited the lack of a real-world case.
improvements.change: A candidate names who hits the problem, with a source, and a failure path needs a real report or captured output. Since 2026-11-10 a separate agent decides build, propose or drop before any code is written.

improvements.happened: First pull requests to new projects were going unanswered. By 2026-11-20 twelve projects had received one pull request each and merged none, and eight of those were still open with no reply from a person.
improvements.change: Before a first pull request, the factory samples whether outsiders' pull requests get a human review within three days, unless a maintainer invited the work. Silent projects are stopped and not pinged.
improvements.moves: Still open: no reply from a person

improvements.happened: On a fix that was never published, the author's checks passed and two rounds of independent review each found a different regression. The record is private; the link is the issue the fix was for.
improvements.change: Review answers a fixed list of ways earlier changes failed (risk classes), each with a signed record of the command that checked it. After a second failed round the agent session running the shift takes the item over or shelves it; this item was shelved on 2026-11-11.

improvements.happened: Until this date the factory said its work was AI-written only where a project asked: 25 of the 129 pull-request descriptions carry such a statement and the other 104 carry none. A statement made only in a comment, as on postcss#2182, is not counted.
improvements.change: New pull requests say they are automated and link to this repository. Projects that ban or restrict AI-generated contributions are not candidates.

methodology: Read-only snapshot of retained local evidence. No network read or GitHub refresh is performed.

The cohort includes PRs opened on or before the date 14 days before the snapshot date (UTC), using exact cached creation timestamps or ledger submission timestamps to establish opening dates. Time of day does not affect membership; undated PRs are excluded and counted.
Drafts, closed, withdrawn and unanswered PRs remain in the cohort merge-rate denominator. Later merges move open rows to merged without changing cohort membership.
Rates need at least 20 eligible PRs. The 95% Wilson interval assumes independent PRs; the repository split shows their clustering. Weekly outcomes are counts, not trend claims.
Merged-without-rework uses only cohort merges with complete histories. Missing histories reduce coverage, never count as clean; unclassified maintainer edits count against the share.
Committer dates proxy ordinary pushes, not exact push times or batches. Force-push times are exact. Merge commits are excluded; removed commits or delayed pushes may be missed.

History stores self/other roles, not human/bot identity. Open response reasons use the saved ledger's human response flags. Open sub-states: awaiting-cla is agreement; otherwise no-reply requires silent status or explicit responded.maintainer=false and responded.community=false, with neither a true human response flag nor in-review/community-review status. A human response flag or in-review/community-review status is in-review; other submissions are unchecked. Source: factory/oss/followup.py:341-351,394-409; factory/oss/submit.py:336-339.

Daily activity uses Asia/Singapore event dates, not the UTC cohort dates. Openings use creation times; merges and unmerged closures use their own terminal times. Reopened PRs count only their current terminal outcome. Recorded replacement pairs are one daily contribution but remain separate PRs in the cohort.

Daily activity carries the last successful GitHub observation time. A failed refresh retains its counts and date window; missing event times remain outside daily rows but inside totals. Today is partial, and waiting time is not a KPI.
All weeks start Monday in UTC. Weekly outcomes reflect the current saved state of every PR opened that week, including recent PRs. Open counts are not historical week-end inventory.
Coverage is eligible records with needed fields / the stated population, not proof of complete historical capture. Missing values are never zero; input read errors and omitted dates can undercount.
Factory speed measures candidate-to-submission work, not waiting for maintainers. Maintainer response, approval and merge latency are not measured.
